This page contains patch notes released on the Official Server.


An update for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang has been released on the Original Server for the month of September, year 2026. This includes the revamped heroes Masha and Bruno, along with adjustments, battlefield changes and in-game events.

The update was released on 16 September 2026, 00:00 server time.

sections.title: From The Designers
sections.html:
In this patch, we've improved several underperforming Jungler and Exp Lane heroes to help them perform better.

To celebrate MLBB's 10th anniversary, this patch also features a comprehensive art overhaul for several iconic heroes from different regions, including Masha, Bruno, Paquito, Kadita, Clint, Luo Yi, Brody, and Badang. We've also revamped and optimized the skill mechanics for Masha and Bruno.

sections.title: I. Revamped Hero
sections.html:
1. 10th Anniversary Revamped Hero: Masha, the Wild-oats Fist

Hero Feature: A Berserker who enters the Feral state by breaking the enemy's wound. Masha's core gameplay has been revamped. We want her to thrive as a high-skill ceiling Berserker capable of sustained combat, rather than an Assassin limited to split-pushing or burst damage.

Passive - Primal Pact Masha has 3 HP bars and dies only when the last one is depleted. Masha gains Feral when dealing damage to heroes or creeps. Feral converts to HP when out of combat. Masha leaves a Wound on the enemy when dealing skill damage to them. Attacking again with a Basic Attack from the direction of the Wound will break it, putting Masha into the Feral state. While in the Feral state, her next 3 Basic Attacks become wide-range claw strikes, and she gains massive Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed.

Skill 1 - Feral Swipe Masha releases energy forward, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing enemy heroes.

Skill 2 - Claw Strike Masha dashes in the target direction, unleashing a wide-range claw strike upon reaching max range or colliding with a non-minion enemy unit. This skill's cooldown resets each time she loses a life.

Ultimate - Savage Maul Masha charges toward the target hero, dealing Physical Damage and stunning them, while knocking back nearby enemies.

2. 10th Anniversary Revamped Hero: Bruno, The Protector

Hero Feature: A Marksman who deals massive damage to enemies by continuously kicking powerballs.

We've made several optimizations to Bruno. While preserving his core identity, we've improved his controls and made adjustments across his kit. These changes make him a more agile and formidable striker.

Skill 1 - Volley Shot ADJUST ~ We believe the original Volley Shot placed too much burden on players. In the current environment, players might fail to pick up the Powerball even after planning their movement and positioning correctly. Therefore, we've optimized it.

[Controls Optimizations]

  • a. The landing distance of Powerball now scales with Bruno's Movement Speed.
  • b. The Movement Speed boost is now granted when kicking the Powerball instead of upon dealing damage.
  • c. The Movement Speed boost now decays over time.
  • d. The landing position of Powerball will no longer cross walls.
  • e. Powerball can now be cast even when affected by control effects (except Silence).
  • f. Powerball now remains on the ground for 3s, up from 2s. Multiple Powerballs can now be retrieved separately.
  • g. Fixed an issue where Bruno would occasionally lose a Powerball while performing his two-Powerball combo.
  • h. Now casting the skill no longer interrupts Basic Attacks.

[Stat Adjustments]

  • Base Damage: 100-225 → 75-150
  • Mana Cost: 60-85 → 50-75

Skill 2 - Slide BUFF ↑ We believe the original skill effect might lead players into relatively dangerous positions. Therefore, we've redesigned the skill to focus more on assisting players with pursuit or escape.

[Controls Optimizations]

  • a. Adjusted the default direction of dash effects to the joystick's direction.
  • b. Now, when Bruno's Powerball begins to bounce back after dealing damage while he is sliding with Flying Tackle, it will tend to land near his dash destination instead of his starting position.

[Mechanics Optimizations] Removed Powerball's pullback effect. Bruno now gains a Powerball when his slide ends.

[Stat Adjustments]

  • Removed the damage effect.
  • Stun Duration: 0.5s → 0.1s
  • Cooldown: 7s at all levels → 9-7s
  • Mana Cost: 60 → 90

Ultimate - Worldie BUFF ↑ We believe the original skill had too many effects, making it difficult to understand and use correctly. Therefore, we've redesigned the skill to focus on initiating team fights from a distance and rapidly gaining Passive stacks.

[Mechanics Optimizations]

  • a. It now applies a brief stun and a massive decaying slow effect on the first target hit, and no longer reduces Physical Defense.
  • b. Optimized the knockback effect on the first target hit. The target will now be knocked back to Bruno's maximum attack range. Knockback & Stun Duration: 0.1s → 0.5s
  • c. Energy Ball now prioritizes enemy heroes when bouncing between enemy units.

[Stat Adjustments]

  • Cast Range: 5.6 → 6
  • First Hit Damage (Base Damage): 250-450 (+ 83% Total Physical Attack) → 200-400 (+80% Total Physical Attack)
  • Bounce Damage (Extra Damage): 150-270 (+50% Total Physical Attack) → 100-200 (+40% Total Physical Attack)

sections.title: III. Battlefield Adjustments
sections.html:
A. In-Match Economy

We've found that matches in the current patch are too fast-paced, making it difficult for teams that fall behind to make a comeback. To address this, we've adjusted battlefield gold income and comeback mechanics for disadvantaged teams.

[Creep] NERF ↓

  • Reduced the Base Gold of the Horned Lizard, Fire Beetle, and Lava Golem by 13%

[Team Bounty] ADJUST ~

  • Gold Deficit Required to Gain Bonus Gold from Enemy Hero Kills: 2,000 → 1,500

[Minions] NERF ↓

  • Slightly reduced minions' Gold reward growth over time.

B. Mythical Honor Battlefield

Edith NERF ↓

  • Reverted skill values to match those outside the Mythical Honor Battlefield.

Tigreal BUFF ↑

Skill 2 Skill 2 BUFF ↑
  • Cooldown: 16-13s → 13-10s

C. Map Changes Update

The 2026 Annual Map Change officially begins on September 28 (Server Time). This update introduces [Revealing Wisps], [Healing Turtle], and [Golden Turret], along with [Flying Cloud], which now features an upgraded art visual effect. Once this goes live, you can check out the full details in the in-game Battlefield Overview tab. Here's a quick overview:

[Revealing Wisps] Pickable Vision Wisps are available across the map. Upon picking one up, the wisp circles around the hero for several seconds. If there are hidden enemy heroes within a large range, the wisp will move to their location and reveal them for several seconds.

[Healing Turtle] Defeating the Turtle no longer grants a shield. Instead, an allied Turtle will spawn on the enemy's strongest lane to help push it. Allied heroes near the allied Turtle will recover HP rapidly and gain Turtle companions to help push turrets.

[Golden Turret] Greatly increased the Gold shared to the entire team when any Turret is destroyed. Inner Turret and Base Turret HP are also increased.

D. Adjusted Turret Interactions for Enhanced Basic Attacks

[Hero Enhanced Basic Attacks]

  • 1. All heroes' Enhanced Basic Attacks triggered by their own skills can now hit Turrets and apply their HP Regen effects.
  • 2. Any exceptions will be clearly noted in the corresponding skill description.
  • 3. Enhanced Basic Attacks from Sun, Argus, Gusion, Thamuz, Dyrroth, and Masha can now trigger HP Regen effects when attacking Turrets.

[Other Enhanced Basic Attacks]

  • 1. Enhanced Basic Attack effects from Emblems, Battle Spells, and Equipment cannot trigger when attacking Turrets.

[Quantum Charge]

  • 1. Cannot trigger when attacking Turrets.
  • 2. When using Inspire to attack Turrets, the Attack Speed boost and defense-ignoring effect still apply, but the HP Regen effect will not trigger.

E. Control Settings Update

We are now factoring in the attacker's Penetration along with the target's Defense and HP to prioritize locking onto the target that is actually the easiest to kill, rather than just the one with the lowest HP.

As a result, in the Targeting Priority options, "Lowest HP" has been optimized to "Lowest Effective HP".

Special Note: Since a large portion of Karina, Karrie, Lesley, and Thamuz's damage is True Damage, they will continue to use the "Lowest HP" targeting rule even when "Lowest Effective HP" is selected.

The original "Closest Target" and "Lowest HP Percent" options remain unchanged. Heroes using these options will not be affected.

F. Basic Attack Targeting Optimizations

We've optimized the targeting mechanics for Basic Attack pursuit, reducing cases where ranged heroes repeatedly switch targets between minions and enemy heroes when pursuing enemies outside their Basic Attack range.

After a Basic Attack hits a hero, tapping the Basic Attack button repeatedly within a short time will now prioritize pursuing and re-attacking that same target, unless a higher-priority enemy hero is within Basic Attack range.

G. Movement Control Optimizations

Added a landing indicator for all dash skills passing through obstacles.

H. Sanctum Island Map Updates

We've fully revamped the art assets for Sanctum Island's scene, lord, and base. The new map now offers better visuals while keeping performance nearly on par with the original. This update takes effect immediately, so please make sure all resources are downloaded before entering the game for the complete experience.

I. Simplified Hero Skill Descriptions

To reduce the length of hero skill descriptions and improve readability, we've replaced some commonly used attributes (Attack, Defense, and Max HP) with simple and intuitive icons.

J. Other

  • 1. Optimized Minsitthar's Skill 1 description.
  • 2. Fixed an issue where Nana's Skill 2 sometimes dealt abnormal damage.
  • 3. Fixed an issue where the control duration in Gloo's Skill 1 description was incorrect.
  • 4. Adjusted the camera height after Layla upgrades her Ultimate, improving visibility at the bottom of the screen.
  • 5. Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, Lieh's Hybrid Defense bonus would not trigger after killing an enemy within his domain.

sections.title: IV. System Adjustments
sections.html:
A. New Custom Setups

To better accommodate player preferences, we've added custom layouts for medium and large buttons in the Custom UI.

B. Career Achievements

Added the [Claim All] feature, allowing you to claim multiple achievement rewards at once.

C. Collection - The MLabel Skin Label

  • 1. The brand-new TheMLabel skin label is officially launched.
  • 2. The Aspirants series is officially added to TheMLabel.
  • 3. Complete the full collection achievement to unlock multiple special privileges and showcase your collector status.
  • 4. You can also switch to the series' customization item overview to plan your collection.
  • 5. Added the label story feature, allowing you to learn the lore behind the skin series.

D. Adjusted Mode Unlock Condition

We've adjusted the unlock conditions for the following three modes:

  • 1. [VS A.I. & Custom]: The unlock condition has been adjusted to reaching Elite rank.
  • 2. [Magic Chess]: The unlock condition has been adjusted to reaching Lv.12.
  • 3. [1 VS 1]: The unlock condition has been adjusted to reaching Lv.25.

E. Multiplayer Training Camp

Added the Multiplayer Training Camp feature. Access it via [Mode] - [VS A.I. & Custom] - [Multiplayer Training Camp].

F. Ranked Mode Season Settlement

  • 1. S41 will end at 21:59:59 on September 15 (Server Time).
  • 2. S42 will start from 00:00:00 on September 16 (Server Time). Complete Ranked matches to claim rewards, including S42 Seasonal Skin: Popol and Kupa "Flamehide Thane" and S42 Avatar Border "Starward Decade".

We hope you enjoy the game and wish you the best in your ranked matches!

G. Auction House

  • 1. Added a display status for items marked "Temporarily Sold Out" in the Auction House.
  • 2. Added the Sale Reminder feature. Add an item to your reminder list, and you'll be notified as soon as it becomes available again, provided you're online and not in a match.
  • 3. Adjusted how owned items are prioritized in the Auction House and updated the related purchasing and usage rules.
  • 4. Optimized how the Auction House list refreshes after a purchase.

H. Mail Optimizations

  • 1. Optimized the red dot notification for unread mail. The red dot will now appear only when you have unread important mail or unread mail with attachments.
  • 2. Optimized the display of important system notifications, battlefield reports, and report feedback mail.
  • 3. Optimized the visuals for mail with attachments.

I. Namecard Feature Revamp

The Namecard feature has been revamped, giving you more ways to express yourself. Check it out to see what's new!

Tap any player's avatar to view their Namecard and explore its new features.

  • 1. Model / Portrait Display: The new Namecard lets you showcase a 3D model or portrait. 3D models feature an entrance animation that showcases your hero in all their glory. Make your Namecard truly yours!
  • 2. ID Card Customization: Equip multiple ID cards, such as Mythic Medal, Collector, Achievement Hall, Season Info, Live Legend, and personalized info cards. Arrange them freely to show off your best side!
  • 3. Namecard Highlights: Memorable in-game moments—such as earning Legendary or Savage, unlocking skins, and winning tournaments—are automatically added to your Highlights. Other players can give each Highlight a Like or Super Like, and each has its own like count. Show off your best moments!
  • 4. Album Namecard Display: The Album module now supports Namecard display. New content is automatically tagged, so your best moments get seen by other players right away!

J. Super Like

To improve the Like experience, we've made comprehensive upgrades to the Like feature:

  • 1. Super Like: Show your friends some extra appreciation with effects that shine brighter than a standard like!
  • 2. Like Records: Added a new page to your Profile where you can view all your like records in one place. You can also like someone back with a single tap.
  • 3. Like Shop: Earning Super Likes lets you build up currency to redeem skins and exclusive banners in the Super Like Shop!

K. Highlights Notification Feature

  • 1. Added a new Highlights Notification area, along with exclusive Highlights Notifications that showcase your own unique highlights.
  • 2. We've also added several new Highlights Notifications to replace some existing ones, along with new hero-exclusive Highlights Notifications. Check them out in your next match!

L. In-Match Likes

  • 1. We've improved the in-match like experience: the like button now shows which player you're liking, with enhanced notification effects as likes accumulate.
  • 2. When you trigger certain Highlight Notifications with an ally, you can like each other to activate a series of new teamwork notifications.

M. Battle Achievement Interface

  • 1. Added a new match result screen showcasing your team's honor. It is currently only shown in Ranked, Classic, and MLBB Rising Open.
  • 2. We've added a new Supreme Medal to reward players with outstanding in-match performance.
  • 3. Earning MVP will also grant the corresponding Supreme MVP Medal. To balance this, we've also adjusted the requirements for earning other medals accordingly.
  • 4. We also improved the feedback for likes on the match result screen, making it quicker to like back players who liked you.

N. 10-Player Match Result Screen

  • 1. We now display Highlights Notifications triggered by players during a match, with each displayed icon counting toward the match score.
  • 2. If there are too many icons, they'll be grouped under a single icon showing the total count. Tap it to view all triggers from the match.

O. Protection Points and Star-raising Points

We've added exclusive Protection Point and Star-raising Point rewards for Supreme Medals. To balance this change, we've adjusted the Star-raising Points and Protection Points for other medals.

P. Season Achievements

We've added Season Achievement rewards. You can now equip them from the Honor Badge screen, or share your Season Achievement level in the lobby and other screens. Starting next season, you'll be able to carry over Season Achievement rewards from the previous season, including Style Plates, Namecards, and Honor Badges, until the end of the current season. We've added new Season Achievement tasks and adjusted the completion requirements for certain levels and tasks, making it easier to progress.

Q. Announcement System Adjustments

[Tab and Content Adjustments] The "Announcements" tab will be removed. Important announcements, including patch notes, monthly events, and balance adjustments, will now be moved to the "News" tab.

[Announcement Notification Update] Announcements will no longer use red dot badges, including those carried over to other menu icons. Announcements requiring special attention will instead be marked with a flame icon.

[Read Announcement Sorting Update] Once read, an announcement will automatically move to the bottom of the "News" tab, making unread announcements easier to find.

[Security Announcement Display Update] Security announcements and related content will be temporarily removed. We plan to make them available through other systems in a future patch.

adjustments.name: Aulus
adjustments.intro: Aulus takes too long to ramp up, struggles to finish off enemies, and lacks survivability in extended fights. We're addressing these issues by accelerating his ramp-up, condensing his damage into a shorter window, and improving his HP Regen.

changes.text: After dealing skill damage to a unit, Aulus gains 2s of Enhanced Basic Attacks (up to 4s).

Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus slams his axe into the ground, dealing damage to targets in a line and recovering his own HP, while applying a slow effect to them. During this state, his Attack Range and Attack Speed are increased.
Enhanced Basic Attack's HP Regen (Per Hit): 30 (+ 15% Total Physical Attack)
Removed Effect: The first cast grants Hybrid Lifesteal upon hitting a target.
New Effect: The first cast stuns targets hit for 0.3s.
The second cast can now be used even if the first cast doesn't hit a target.

adjustments.name: Argus
adjustments.intro: Based on your feedback, we've decided to make another round of balance adjustments and gameplay improvements to Argus. Argus can now trigger Demonic Slash more often and stun enemies with Skill 2. The increased Ultimate damage helps him counterattack or secure kills.

changes.text: New Effect: Argus gains 30% initial Crit Chance.

Effect Adjustment: Argus's Crit now triggers an additional Demonic Slash instead of dealing extra damage, but can still trigger other critical-hit effects, including those from Berserker's Fury and Windtalker.
After a charge, he thrusts his Meteoric Sword, dealing damage and stunning targets hit. Hitting an enemy hero grants an extra Attack Speed bonus.
Removed Effect: Meteoric Sword no longer Crits. Its damage now scales with Crit Chance and Crit Damage.
New Effect: Damage now benefits from 40% of Crit Chance and Crit Damage.

If the Ultimate is not on cooldown and Argus takes fatal damage, the Ultimate automatically triggers death immunity for 4s, but does not deal damage. The Ultimate's damage increases as Argus's HP decreases, by up to 50%, reaching the maximum when his HP falls below 30%.

adjustments.name: Aldous
adjustments.intro: Exp Lane heroes need to serve as a primary force in early-game skirmishes. Aldous's reliance on Skill 1 stacks for damage forced him to farm passively in the early game, leaving him completely out of sync with the team's pace. To boost his early-game combat capability and income while keeping his core playstyle intact, we've made the following adjustments.

New Effect: Gains 5 stacks of Soul Steal if the attack hits an enemy hero.

Removed Effect: Increased the bounce speed and frequency of Passive's sound wave during the Ultimate.

adjustments.name: Classic Zilong
adjustments.intro: We've noticed that Classic Zilong was a bit too strong, even proving hard to handle in Classic mode. As a result, we've reduced his damage and how often he gains Control Immunity. That said. Even after these adjustments, Classic Zilong can still pick off enemy heroes amid the chaos of battle.

adjustments.name: Sun
adjustments.intro: We've noticed that roaming Sun takes too many resources away from his teammates, negatively affecting their experience. We've therefore made targeted adjustments to rein in his roaming build while minimizing the impact on his performance in other lanes.

changes.text: To offset the changes to the Doppelganger's cooldown and attributes, we've adjusted some values of Sun's Passive to keep its overall effectiveness unchanged.
The Doppelganger inherits all of Sun's attributes, but the damage it deals is reduced, and it takes extra damage.

adjustments.name: Kalea
adjustments.intro: Kalea's damage and survivability as a Fighter-Support have both fallen short this patch, making her one of the weakest supports right now. To address this, we've decided to give her a comprehensive buff so she can truly perform as a Fighter-Support.

adjustments.name: Hanabi
adjustments.intro: Hanabi dealt excessive damage to a single target through consecutive Petal Blade bounces in small-scale team fights. To preserve her single-target poke during the laning phase, we haven't changed her base bounce damage. Instead, we've added a bounce damage falloff: when a Basic Attack or skill bounces repeatedly hits the same target, subsequent bounces deal less damage, limiting her sustained output against a single target within a short time.

adjustments.name: Yi Sun-shin
adjustments.intro: Yi Sun-shin's overall mobility was too high, so we've increased Skill 1's cooldown to limit his dash frequency.

adjustments.name: Alpha
adjustments.intro: Alpha's early-game laning was relatively weak, so we've adjusted his Passive to scale with Total Physical Attack, improving his early- to mid-game performance. We've also optimized Skill 2's Regen mechanics by increasing its base HP recovered per hit and reducing the additional HP recovered per hit, improving its sustain when hitting a single target.

An update for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang has been released on the Original Server for the month of June, year 2026. This includes the new hero Hirara, along with hero adjustments, battlefield changes, equipment adjustments and the start of Season 41.

The update was released on 17 June 2026, 00:00 server time.

sections.title: From the Designers
sections.html: In this patch, we've boosted most traditional Roaming heroes (including Tanks and backline Supports) to help them perform better in the new season. We've also adjusted the early-game pacing in the jungle. Junglers on the leading team now have more flexible farming routes, while Junglers who are behind have more room to maneuver when their jungle is invaded.

sections.title: III. Battlefield Adjustments
sections.html:
A. Control Optimizations

  • Added the Avatar Quick Cast feature in the skill settings. Under [Lock-on Targeting], you can now drag directional skills directly to a hero's avatar for a quick cast.
  • Optimized targeting logic in [Lock-on Targeting] mode: Within 3s of losing a hero lock, if no new targets are acquired, the previous lock will be restored.
  • Optimized the locking status display in [Lock-on Targeting] mode: Casting a skill on a locked enemy hero will no longer change the current hero lock status.
  • We've optimized the skill caching logic. The enhanced Basic Attacks of the following heroes will now be cached and no longer be interrupted by skills: Saber, Alucard, Karina, Bane, Clint, Zilong, Lolita, Natalia, Chou, Estes, Hilda, Lapu-Lapu, Gatotkaca, Grock, Argus, Odette, Hylos, Lesley, Gusion, Kaja, Selena, Aldous, Belerick, Thamuz, Harith, Badang, Khufra, Guinevere, Ling, Dyrroth, Masha, Yu Zhong, Khaleed, Mathilda, Phoveus, Aulus, Aamon, Edith, Yin, Julian, Fredrinn, Nolan, Chip, Lukas, and Kalea.
  • We've optimized the skill buffering mechanic: when your hero is controlled, quickly releasing the skill will stop it from being buffered, preventing accidental casts when the control effect ends.
    • If you release a skill within 0.3s after a control effect is applied to your hero, the skill will not be buffered.
    • If you release it after 0.3s, the skill will be buffered and cast automatically when the control effect ends.

B. Skill Wheel Aiming Optimizations

  • Added [Skill Wheel Size] to [Skill Settings], allowing you to adjust the skill wheel size and improve aiming.
  • Added [Cast Slip Protection] to [Skill Settings], allowing you to adjust the slip protection area size of the skill joystick. Releasing inside the protection area triggers auto-cast. Releasing outside triggers a manual cast.

C. Custom UI Settings Optimizations

  • Custom UI settings are now supported during matches and take effect immediately after modification.

D. Equipment Adjustments

[Roaming Blessings] BUFF ↑

  • To improve the flexibility of Roaming Blessings, all Roaming Blessings can now gain EXP and Gold by dealing damage, revealing vision, and sharing income from minions and creeps, but the income gained each time has been reduced.
  • We acknowledge that damage-oriented Roamers can generate Gold for the team by harassing enemies. However, we do not encourage the playstyle of boosting themselves by taking gold from minions and creeps killed by their allies. Therefore, we have extended the duration during which heroes with Roaming Blessings receive reduced Gold from minions and creeps when alone.
    • Duration of Reduced Gold from Minions and Creeps When Alone: 5 min → 8 min
    • Solo Income from Minions and Creeps in the First 8 Minutes: 50% → 30%

[Roaming Blessing - Dire Hit] ADJUST ~ (Revamped)

  • Gains Force while moving, gradually increasing Movement Speed (up to 40 stacks). Upon reaching 20 stacks, the next skill or Basic Attack consumes all stacks, dealing extra damage based on the number of stacks.

[Roaming Blessing - Conceal] BUFF ↑

  • Cooldown: 80s → 60s

[Rapid Boots] ADJUST ~

In the current fast-paced meta, combats occur more frequently, leaving less time to be out of combat. Therefore, we've removed the out-of-combat Movement Speed boost and increased the base Movement Speed.
  • Movement Speed: 65 → 55
  • Unique Passive - Side Effect: Removed

[Berserker's Fury] BUFF ↑

We've noticed that Crit-based heroes were struggling to see play, as their damage against frontline heroes fell far behind that of Attack Speed and Effect heroes. To address this, we've given Crit-based heroes more ways to damage frontline heroes, while keeping their damage against the backline unchanged.
  • Physical Attack: 65 → 60
  • Crit Damage: 40% → 30%
  • Unique Passive - Doom (Revamped): When Basic Attacks Crit, they deal extra True Damage equal to 12% of the damage before reduction.

E. Jungle Adjustment

[Retribution] BUFF ↑

To alleviate Jungler heroes' weakness when invaded by multiple enemies in the early game, we've made some optimizations and provided more possible jungle routes.
  • Basic Retribution Damage: 520 (+ 80 × Hero Level) → 750 (+ 150 × Hero Level)
  • Advanced Retribution Damage: 780 (+ 120 × Hero Level) → 750 (+ 150 × Hero Level)

[Creeps] ADJUST ~

  • Reduced the base EXP of Thunder Fenrir and Molten Fiend, and increased the base EXP of other creeps, while keeping the total EXP needed to reach Lv. 4 by killing 5 creeps unchanged.
  • Killing the Horned Lizard, Fire Beetle, and Lava Golem will immediately level you up to Lv. 2, and their first respawn time has been moved up to 25s.
  • Increased the base HP of the Horned Lizard, Fire Beetle, Lava Golem, and Thunder Fenrir, and reduced the base HP of the Molten Fiend.
  • Slightly increased the late-game Gold rewards provided by the Horned Lizard, Fire Beetle, Lava Golem, Thunder Fenrir, and Molten Fiend.

F. Other Adjustments

[UI Optimizations for Resplendent Skins in the Hero Selection Screen]

  • Optimized the UI for Resplendent Skins in the Hero Selection Screen. During the Pick & Ban phase, once a player confirms a Resplendent Skin, all players in the match will immediately see its visual effects. Different dragonshard colors correspond to exclusive visual effects.

[Ultimate Visual Effect Adjustments for Certain Heroes] Added and improved the visual effect indicators for the Ultimate of certain heroes:

  • Pharsa: Added a visual effect indicator on the Ultimate button after using the Ultimate.
  • Harith: Added a visual effect indicator on the Skill 2 button after using the Ultimate.
  • Ixia: Added a visual effect indicator on the Enhanced Basic Attack button after using the Ultimate.

G. Mythical Honor Battlefield

As MLBB's player base and hero roster grow, we are testing a new balancing approach: applying hero stat adjustments specifically to the Mythical Honor Battlefield. Our goal is to promote hero diversity in high-rank and tournament matches without affecting the experience in other ranks.

Alpha BUFF ↑

Ultimate Ultimate BUFF ↑
  • Cooldown: 20-16s → 16-12s

Edith BUFF ↑

Skill 2 Skill 2 BUFF ↑
  • Cooldown: 10-8s → 8.5-6.5s

Dyrroth BUFF ↑

Skill 2 Skill 2 BUFF ↑
  • Abyss Enhanced reduces the target's Physical Defense by: 60% → 75%

Melissa BUFF ↑

Skill 1 Skill 1 BUFF ↑
  • Cooldown: 5-3.5s → 4.5-3s

Cecilion BUFF ↑

Passive Passive BUFF ↑
  • Max Mana Increase and Mana Regen Upon Skill Hit: 10 → 12


H. Bush Vision Optimizations

Optimized the delayed vision loss logic when entering or leaving bushes: The vision delay now only applies when both sides are visible to each other, ensuring a more consistent experience during bush encounters.

[Entering a Bush]

  • When entering a bush with an enemy hero nearby, the player will enter the Conceal state after a 330ms delay → When entering a bush with an enemy hero nearby and both sides are visible to each other, the player will enter the Conceal state after a 330ms delay

[Leaving a Bush]

  • New Effect: When a player leaves a bush, enemy heroes inside the bush remain visible for 330ms.

I. Layla Skill Description Optimization

  • Optimized the descriptions of Layla's Skill 2 and Passive to better match the actual effects and make them easier to understand.

sections.title: IV. System Adjustments
sections.html:
A. Ranked

  • S40 will end at 21:59:59 on 06/16 (Server Time).
  • S41 will start from 00:00:00 on 06/17 (Server Time). Complete Ranked matches to claim rewards, including S41 Seasonal Skin: Zhask "Icespawn Scourge" and S41 Avatar Border "Scarlet Embers".
We wish you an enjoyable gaming experience and smooth rank progression!

B. Highlights

[Feature Overview]

  • After a match, players with outstanding performance will have the option to generate Highlights. Once confirmed, the cloud will automatically create the Highlights for the match without affecting game performance. When the Highlights are ready, players can download and save them, or tap [Share] to post them on social media.

[Rules]

  • Highlights are currently only available in Classic and Ranked modes.
  • Supports two Highlight generation methods: [Use Template] and [Without Template]. Template Highlights include built-in music and cinematic effects. You can switch between these methods before each generation.
  • Tap the prompt on the post-match screen to create the video. Once it's ready, you can view it via Live > My Videos.
  • If you miss the prompt on the post-match screen, you can also create it via Live > My Videos > Match Replays.

C. Other Adjustments

[Hero Difficulty Rating Update]

  • To provide more accurate hero roles and in-match difficulty references, we've re-evaluated and updated the difficulty ratings for most heroes on the Official Server. The new ratings will better reflect the current match environment.
  • The specific changes have been synced to each hero's details screen. Please feel free to check them out.

[Twilight Coin Sacred Statue Updates]

  • Kimmy "Sky Blazer" Sacred Statue will be available soon—estimated 06/17. Stay tuned.

[Auction House Optimizations]

  • Added a Recent Sale Price display to the [Buy] and [Sell] screens. Tap to view the item's last 20 sale prices.

sections.title: V. Game Modes/Mode Adjustments
sections.html:
A. Brawl

[Map Visual Updates]

The new Necrokeep-themed Brawl map is here! The Land of Dawn faces an unprecedented crisis. Upon the walkways of Necrokeep, invaders driven by greed attempt to completely unleash the Mist. In response, Queen Vexana has chosen to awaken her defender army of the Mist's seal to stand ready. On this narrow path, a fight to the death is inevitable! Every warrior must hold the line and keep the curse of the Mist sealed. For the future of the Land of Dawn, let the Brawl begin!

[Map Mechanics Adjustments]

  • Equipment can still be purchased for 5s after leaving the Base, but this will end early upon entering combat.
  • Added a new showcase skill. Use it to display your Recall animations and visual effects. This skill provides no actual effects.
  • Extended the barrel's duration to 30s. It can be picked up again 60s after the initial pickup. The pickup cooldown is tied to each hero, allowing multiple players to pick up barrels at the same time.
  • Added Flying Clouds near the Base, allowing players to quickly reach the battlefield. Its cooldown will reset upon respawn.

[Hero Pool Updates]

  • New Hero Added to the Brawl Random Hero Pool: Faramis.

[Hero Balance Adjustments]

Based on recent Brawl hero win and pick rates, we've made balance adjustments.

newHeroes.name: Hirara
lore: Soul ablaze with crimson maples, she drifts toward the dark waters of the Meisen.

A geisha ninja from the Scarlet Shadow, she defies all odds to return, wielding the legendary Twin Fans: Ukifune. She dances across the battlefield with grace, reaping with her elegant yet lethal twin fan combos. Every strike is a tribute—the ultimate protection for the master she serves, Hanabi.

description: [Twins Fans: Ukifune] consists of two weapons: [Meisen-e] and [Kaerazu]. Skill 1 and 2 represents the abilities of these two weapons respectively. The skills can be cast individually or combined by dragging.
Hirara has 2 stacks of [Crimson / Death] Energy. Casting a combo skill costs 1 stack of Energy.

This page contains patch notes released on the Official Server.


An update for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang has been released on the Original Server for the month of April, year 2026. This includes the revamp hero Aulus, along with adjustments, battlefield changes and in-game events.

The update was released on 21 April 2026, 00:00 server time.

sections.title: From The Designers
sections.html: In this patch, we've adjusted the durability attributes of Gold Lane Marksmen based on their early-game laning strength and late-game power. Those with strong early-game laning capabilities have lower base durability, while those with high late-game mobility or long range have lower durability growth. We've also adjusted their base Movement Speed attribute based on their mobility. We've also adjusted Mana Costs for most Gold Lane Marksmen so they are closer to the average Mana Costs of Marksmen.

D. Tidal Gold Rush Gameplay

  • Complete matches in Classic, Ranked, or MLBB Rising Open to get extra Tidal Bounty Chests and Treasure Hunt Coins, which can be exchanged for event rewards. For more details, please refer to the in-game event screen.
  • [Available Time]

    2. Each time your team kills the Lord (starting from the 2nd kill).

    2. Each time you get an assist.

sections.title: III. Battlefield Adjustments
sections.html:
A. Lane Adjustment

Recommended Lane & Equipment Optimization
  • To adapt to the current laning meta, we have optimized the recommended lane and recommended equipment for certain heroes based on the latest match data and player feedback.


B. Equipment Adjustment

[Roaming Blessings]

Different types of Roaming heroes have different playstyles, so we've reworked how some Roaming Blessings gain extra Gold and EXP.
As match time increases, Gold from minions and creeps rises, while vision reveals and damage opportunities for roamers decrease in the late game. Therefore, we've adjusted the reward values for Roaming heroes' different actions to balance the Gold income of different Roaming styles.

[All Blessings] BUFF ↑

  • Gold Gained from Vision Reveal: 30 → 30 (+ 1* Hero Level)
  • EXP Gained from Vision Reveal: 30 in first 2 min, 60 after 2 min → 25 + (5* Hero Level)
  • Gold Gained Every 5s After 8 Min: 9 → 10
  • EXP Gained Every 5s After 8 Min: 18 → 20


Active - Conceal & Passive - Dire Hit ADJUST ~

No longer gains income from minions and creeps killed by nearby allies.
  • New Effect: Gain (30 + 2* Hero Level) Gold and (20 + 8* Hero Level) EXP after dealing damage to enemy heroes. Cooldown: 15s.


Passive - Encourage & Passive - Favor NERF ↓

  • Income from Minions and Creeps Killed by Nearby Allies: 40% → 35%

Passive - Encourage ADJUST ~

  • Grants nearby allied heroes 20 Hybrid Defense.


 Demon Hunter Sword BUFF ↑

Enhanced hero's sustainability provided by the three-piece Attack Speed equipment set.

 Rose Gold Meteor ADJUST ~

Adjusted the equipment scaling to make it easier to reach the max Hybrid Defense from equipment. Removed the dependency on Lifesteal from Basic Attacks to improve flexibility, and slightly reduced Physical Attack for balance.

Physical Attack: 40 → 30

[Unique Passive - Dragon Scale] BUFF ↑
  • Every 1% Lifesteal increases Hybrid Defense by 1 → Every 4 extra Physical Attack increases Hybrid Defense by 1
[Unique Passive - Lifeline] BUFF ↑

 Queen's Wings BUFF ↑

Optimized Queen's Wings' Passive - Demonize. This effect now requires taking damage from enemy heroes to trigger.


 Demon Hunter Sword NERF ↓

Slightly nerfed the equipment's HP recovery potential.

You can now gain Hero Power in the MLBB Rising Open system. As your MRO level increases, the Hero Power bonus also increases. New Free Recording

You can enable this feature in Settings - Free Recording to view and share your recorded videos. Once enabled, a draggable floating recording button will appear in matches, allowing you to quickly record gameplay highlights (due to performance considerations, this feature is disabled on some low-performance devices).


Battle Achievement Video Sharing

You can tap to record the full animation on the Battle Achievement screen. The recorded video can be shared on social platforms or saved locally (due to performance considerations, this feature is disabled on some low-performance devices).


Highlights Notification Optimizations

Added "Clutch Control" highlight. Trigger condition: Perform Clutch Control in team fights and assist allies in killing key enemy heroes. Added "Superb AOE / Brilliant AOE / Flawless AOE" highlights. Trigger condition: Hit multiple enemies with an AOE skill, deal massive damage, and secure kills.


Result Screen Optimization

On the Result Screen, tap another player's avatar to view their Namecard. You can also view the basic info and skill info of the hero they played in this match within the Namecard.


Other

sections.title: From the Designers
sections.html: In this patch, we've optimized some underused heroes to give them more opportunities to shine. This includes Hanzo, who has long been overlooked and is now getting a revamp. We've also slighty toned down some overly popular heroes. We hope these adjustments, along with optimizations to certain equipment, will create a more diverse and dynamic ranked environment.

sections.title: I. New & Revamped Heroes
sections.html:
Revamped Hero: Akuma Ninja - Hanzo

  • Hero Feature: A ninja who combines Ninjutsu with Demon Blood, able to transform into Hanekage to reap enemies from afar before returning to safety.

Hanzo's Ninjutsu has been refined. Even without his Ultimate, Hanzo's base form now has some combat capabilities.

Hanzo no longer needs to accumulate Demon Blood to cast his Ultimate. Now Hanzo gains fixed energy when casting the Ultimate, and Hanzo's body becomes invincible when the Ultimate is active.

We've also optimized Hanzo's normal skills to provide a smoother killing experience.

Passive - Ame no Habakiri ADJUST ~
  • Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attack or skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu] on the target, up to 5 stacks. Each stack of [Dark Ninjutsu] increases the damage of Skill 1.
Skill 1 - Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
  • The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of [Dark Ninjutsu]. If the target is a Common Creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover HP.
  • Deals Physical Damage to heroes and True Damage to the Turtle and the Lord.
Skill 1 (Hanekage) - Forbidden Ninjutsu: Soul Snatch
  • Hanekage dashes to an enemy hero, dealing damage after a brief delay. Each stack of [Dark Ninjutsu] on the target increases this damage. When the target has max stacks of [Dark Ninjutsu], an additional high amount of damage is dealt and Hanzo recovers HP.
Skill 2 - Ninjutsu: Soul Reap
  • Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving a Dark Mist in his path, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them. The Dark Mist provides Hanzo with a Movement Speed boost.
Skill 2 (Hanekage) - Forbidden Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
  • Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path airborne and leaving a Dark Mist that deals Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slows them.
Ultimate - Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
  • Hanzo leaves his body behind (invincible during this period) and charges into battle as Hanekage with enhanced skills, consuming energy every second (can be reduced with Purple Buff). When nearby units die, Hanekage gains energy. When energy is depleted, Hanzo's body will gradually be pulled toward Hanekage's current position (Hanzo and Hanekage share the same HP).
  • When casting this skill again or when Hanekage is killed, Hanekage will quickly return to Hanzo's body (becoming untargetable and recovering a small amount of HP during the process). If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will suffer a 50% Movement Sped reduction and have his position revealed for 6s.

We're making her more aggressive by differentiating her 3 HP bars and making each skill cast count, while allowing her to enter and exit the fight at will under certain conditions. In the meantime, players will have to be more careful with the timing of each skill cast (especially with only one HP bar left) as she has lost some of her durability advantages. We're also adding the Jungle as her secondary position and changing her default Battle Setup. (Masha needs equipment to provide extra Attack Speed and HP Regen rather than Defense.) Attributes buff

This page contains patch notes released on the Official Server.


An update for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang has been released on the Original Server for the month of December, year 2024. This includes the new hero Lukas, along with hero adjustments, equipment changes, the launch of MLBB Rising Open, and the start of Season 35.

The update was released on 18 December 2024, 00:00 server time.

sections.title: From The Designers
sections.html:
We've noticed that some Fighter heroes ( Sun, Argus, Aulus, Zilong, etc.) rely too heavily on Basic Attack output, lacking both the burst damage of skill-based Fighters and the range advantage of Marksmen. This makes it difficult for them to find their suitable role in the game, being very weak in the early game and only able to split push in the late game.

We aim to optimize these heroes. Additionally, we hope that through changes to Rose Gold Meteor, these Fighters that rely on Basic Attacks can have durability not significantly lower than other semi-tank Fighters, even without purchasing defensive equipment.

sections.title: I. New & Revamped Hero
sections.html:
New Hero: Beast of Light - Lukas

Hero Feature: A Fighter who can unleash his power to transform into a Sacred Beast and dominate the battlefield.

This hero will be available on 12/21 (Server Time).

Passive - Hero's Resolve Lukas gains [Resolve] over time or by dealing damage to enemy heroes. When [Resolve] is full, he can cast his Ultimate to transform into Sacred Beast form.

Skill 1 - Flash Combo Lukas can enhance Flash Combo with his Basic Attacks. When casting the Skill, Lukas unleashes Pulverize and consumes all Vigor to deliver additional attacks, stunning and damaging enemies in range. He recovers HP when hitting an enemy hero.

Skill 2 - Flash Step Lukas quickly dashes in the target direction and enhances his next Basic Attack into [Flash Strike]. When casting [Flash Strike], Lukas blinks behind the enemy, gains Attack Speed and Movement Speed for a duration, and summons lightning storms with Basic Attacks to deal Extra Damage.

Ultimate - Unleash the Beast Lukas unleashes his full power and transforms into his Sacred Beast form, greatly enhancing his attributes, empowering all skills, and gaining access to [Shockwave Blast]. While in Sacred Beast form, tap Ultimate again to cast [Shockwave Blast], firing a bomb in the target direction to deal high Damage in a large area.

sections.title: III. Battlefield Adjustments
sections.html:
A. Equipment Adjustments

 Malefic Gun NERF ↓

We're delighted to see the equipment adjustments revitalizing some classic Marksmen, with Layla even making an appearance at M6. However, certain Marksmen have gained benefits that slightly exceeded our expectations. We will slightly reduce the increase in Attack Range and shorten the duration of the Movement Speed boost from Basic Attacks, making this effect only achievable with sufficient Attack Speed in the mid-to-late game.
  • Unique Passive - Malefic Energy NERF ↓
    • Increase Attack Range: 15% → 12%
    • Movement Speed Boost Duration: 1s → 0.5s

 Rose Gold Meteor BUFF ↑

We aim to let certain Fighters that rely on Basic Attacks have durability not significantly lower than other semi-tank Fighters, even without purchasing defensive equipment.
  • Attributes ADJUST ~
    • Physical Attack: 60 → 40
    • Attack Speed: 0 → 20%
    • Removed Magic Defense (the new Passive effect will increase Hybrid Defense).
  • Unique Passive - Dragon Scale BUFF ↑ (New)
    • Every 1% Lifesteal increases Hybrid Defense by 1, up to 50 (effect is halved for non-Fighter heroes).
  • Due to the rework of Rose Gold Meteor, we hope to balance the Lifesteal attributes for equipment with Attack Speed and equipment with Crit Chance.

 Haas' Claws ADJUST ~

  • Attributes ADJUST ~
    • Lifesteal: 25% → 20%
    • Physical Attack: 30 → 40

 Demon Hunter Sword BUFF ↑

  • Attributes BUFF ↑
    • New Effect: +8% Lifesteal
  • Unique Passive - Devour BUFF ↑
    • Lifesteal Granted per Basic Attack: 3% → 2%

B. Battlefield Control Optimization

  • 1. Added a 0.1s protection delay to canceling skills to prevent accidental cancellations during casting.
  • 2. Optimized the targeting logic for Auto Attack or Auto Attack filter under poor network conditions.
  • 3. Slightly reduced the activation range of the Last Hit Attack for Turret, preventing activation when the hero is too far away from the Turret.
  • 4. Added post-channeling calibration for target-location and directional skills to improve accuracy.
  • 5. Increased the skill wheel size for large-range skills (especially target-location skills) based on their skill range, to improve targeting accuracy.
  • 6. The Controls > Moving Pursuit setting now also applies to skills that trigger pursuits.

C. Bug Fixes

  • 1. Fixed an issue where Fanny's Skill 1 would occasionally be triggered twice or not at all when she cast her Skill 2 consecutively.
  • 2. Fixed an issue where Fanny's Skill 1 would occasionally be triggered abnormally when she gained Power of Cyclone and cast her Skill 2.
  • 3. Fixed an issue where the cooldown of Clint's Ultimate displayed on the skill description page did not match the actual cooldown.
  • 4. Fixed an issue where Aulus's Damage Reduction percentage after upgrading Skill 1 did not match its description.
  • 5. Fixed an issue where the description of Yi Sun-shin's Passive Movement Speed boost didn't match the actual effect.
  • 6. Fixed an issue where the description of Bane's Ultimate slow effect didn't match the actual effect.

D. Other Adjustments

  • 1. Optimized the icon and description of Thamuz's Passive buff.
  • 2. A reminder to purchase  Throw Forbidden will now be triggered when you are repeatedly thrown by an allied Jawhead.
  • 3. We have revamped the Moniyan Display Background. Heroes like Tigreal now have a brand new Display Background.

sections.html:
A. MLBB Rising Open

The new [MLBB Rising Open] is now live! Participate to level up your Esports Player rank, earn Honorary Titles, and win rich rewards! Based on your Neighborhood location, we've designed an exclusive Road to Champion and Champion titles, letting more players witness your incredible strength!

[Open Schedule]

  • The MLBB Rising Open will be held on Friday/Saturday evenings (exact start times may vary by region).

[Entry Requirements]

  • Players who have reached Epic rank or above are eligible to participate in the MLBB Rising Open.

[Participation Guide]

  • Players who meet the participation requirements can participate alone or in teams of two, three, or even five.
  • You can invite friends to form your own Esports team and recruit more teammates through Team Recruitment or the Neighborhood Map to build a full Esports team and compete together in the Regional Championship.
  • Players will receive free MLBB Rising Open challenge attempts each week. You can earn additional attempts through the Task system and MRO Shop. Don't worry if you run out of attempts for the week - you can continue challenging failed tournament stages next week!

[Tournament Format]

[Breakout Stage]

  • Achieve three victories within your limited weekly challenge attempts to become the Weekly Champion, receiving the champion title and corresponding tier rewards.
  • After becoming Weekly Champion for 4 weeks, you'll advance to the Division Qualifiers. The competition in this stage will become more challenging, and tickets will become rarer. Additionally, players who have reached the Division Qualifier cannot team up with players who haven't qualified for this stage.
  • Players who become champions in the final round of Division Qualifiers will qualify for the Championship and receive seasonal access to the MLBB Rising Open Exclusive Skin.

[Championship Stage]

  • Win the final round of Division Qualifiers to qualify for the Division Championship.
  • Teams must register as 5-player Esports teams for the Division Championship. Your team will compete in multiple rounds of best-of-one (BO1) matches, with each victory improving your ranking and eliminating your opponents.
  • The top 100 teams in each Division will receive exclusive Division Ranking Titles.
  • In the Live Stream interface, you can watch the Championship matches in real time and enjoy the spectacular plays of top players.

[Championship Finals]

  • The top 100 teams in each Division will receive exclusive Division Ranking Titles. The final 8 teams will compete in best-of-three (BO3) matches for the Champion title and generous Diamond rewards!

The MCL mode will be discontinued after the MLBB Rising Open launches server-wide. After the update, we'll remove MCL Entrance Tickets from the Shop, Squad, and Celestial Chests. All previously earned MCL honors will remain on display. Thank you for your support and love for MCL.

For example: If Player A participates in a 5-player Ranked match with other members of the Squad and is at Mythic 101 stars or above, the Squad Power bonus after winning will be calculated based on 100 Mythic stars.

  • If a Squad Leader remains inactive for 28 consecutive days, leadership will automatically transfer to another Squad member with higher Active Points. This mechanism does not apply to Certified Squads.

  • 1. Added a quick Build adjustment feature during matches. You can now quickly modify your preset equipment order in the In-match Shop.

  • 1. Optimized the UI display of rank icons for Mythic and above ranks in the Main Interface for better visual presentation.

  • 6. Optimized Report System: Added rule descriptions in the report email feedback, helping players better understand the criteria for rule violations.

  • 2. Fixed an issue where names could be recolored during matches.

adjustments.name: Sun
adjustments.intro: We've enhanced Sun's burst damage and crowd control to improve his ganking potential as a Jungler. We've also increased his early-game sustainability to strengthen his ability to farm in the EXP Lane. However, we're reducing his sustained damage output to maintain balance.

adjustments.name: Argus
adjustments.intro: Argus has an exceptionally high win rate in high-rank matches, mainly due to his strong 1v1 potential and corresponding split-pushing and base-taking abilities after getting core items. However, his weak early-to-mid game laning phase and awkward positioning in teamfights contradict his theme as a powerful Fallen Angel wielding the Meteoric Sword. Therefore, we've given Argus a new Ultimate that can turn the tide in teamfights, and strengthened his early-to-mid game laning phase, while reducing his skill damage and split-pushing power accordingly.

sections.title: Match-related Adjustments
sections.html:
Scavenger Crabs

To reduce the number of times the advantaged team would leave before killing the Scavenger Crab and the opposing team would easily finish the job, we reduced the Scavenger Crab's HP Regen interval and increased its HP Regen efficiency upon leaving the fight.

Current of the Turtle

The issue with Current is that just when players want to step on it to help their teammates, the Movement Speed bonus ends. Therefore, we decided to extend the duration of Current.

Duration of Current: 10s → 15s

Lord

Some Junglers still prefer to spend their time fighting the Lord. Now the longer you fight the Lord, the higher the "price" you have to pay.

New Effect: When the Lord is aggro, increase Physical Penetration by 10% per second up to 10 times. (Reverted the Regen Reduction effect from the last Advanced Server patch.)

Currently, the Lord serves the dual purpose of providing team economy and increasing push pressure. We want to increase the push pressure of the Lord while decreasing the team economy they provide to balance the advantage gained by the team that takes them.

Lord (Neutral)

Exp Provided: -25%

Gold Provided: -26 to -36% (scales with match time)

Lord (Summoned)

HP: +30%

Minion Adjustments

We've noticed that Mages are now having difficulty on clearing lanes in the late game (especially when facing Super Minions after Base Turrets have been destroyed). To change this, we've reduced the Magic Defense of some Minions while increasing the defense of the allied Lord in the late game to balance out the overall duration of the match.

1. Reduced the base Magic Defense of Siege Minions and Special Siege Minions by 20, and their Magic Defense growth per minute by 1.

2. Reduced the base Magic Defense of Advanced Melee Minions and Advanced Ranged Minions by 30.

3. Increased the Physical and Magic Defense growth per minute of allied Lord by 1.5.

Spawn Point

Optimized the speed of Spawn Point's HP Regen. The Regen speed is doubled, but the amount of HP recovered each time has been halved (total Regen time remains unchanged).

Bounty System Optimization

The Killing Spree Bounty and Team Bounty systems have always helped the disadvantaged team catch up to the advantaged team, giving them a chance to turn the tables.

However, the current bounty system lacks awareness, resulting in many players still being unfamiliar with it, making it difficult to implement tactics that target high-bounty enemies in the match.

In this patch, we have added a display of the current bounty amount for each hero on the scoreboard (only displayed if the bounty is more than 120 Gold), indicating the extra Gold the killer can get for eliminating that hero. We hope this will help players make better use of this mechanism to plan their tactics.

Additional Notes: The Killing Spree Bounty increases with the number of consecutive kills the hero makes, but is only awarded to the player who ends the spree. The Team Bounty increases by the amount the hero is ahead of the opposing team's average economy. When a leading hero is killed, the Team Bounty is distributed to all players on the killer's team.

Appearance Order of Purchasable Equipment

Previously, without "Pre-Order", the cheapest Equipment would always appear in the top right corner.of the game, but in most cases, it is more cost-effective to build high-level Equipment than to buy a lot of cheaper individual parts, so we have adjusted the order in which the purchasable Equipment appears.

For example, if a player purchases Corrosion Scythe, the optimal choice would be to purchase Swift Crossbow, which will now appear in the "left to right" order of the Equipment Build Path, and no other low-level purchasable Equipment will appear until the Swift Crossbow is obtained.

At the same time, we've changed the order of some Equipment build paths to ensure that in mostncases the optimal order of build pieces is "left to right".

Map Adjustments

1. The new Sanctum Island is now available on the Advanced Server! With better performance on.devices and improved visuals for walls, bushes, and the Cyclone Eye, as well as many classic ML elements waiting to be discovered!

2. Western Desert will be removed.

3. All maps will apply the Lord and Creep resources from Sanctum Island for better visuals and clarity.

Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where the enhanced Basic Attack effect of Gusion's Passive would not interrupt properly under certain circumstances.

2. Fixed an issue where Zhask's summons would occasionally lose their Spawn Effect.

3. Fixed an issue in Training Camp where the infinite skill option would not carry over when switching heroes.

Other Adjustments

1. Optimized Yin's visuals and added a seal timer during his Ultimate.

2. Optimized the graphic performance of Yu Zhong and Ling.

3. Optimized the Retribution for some heroes. Now, Saber can use Retribution while casting Ultimate.

4. Improved visuals in large-scale team fights with high graphics settings.

5. Optimized the Passive description of Jawhead to match the actual targets affected.

6. Optimized the icons and skill visuals of some new equipment.

7. Optimized the display of Defense attributes in the in-match Attributes panel. Now you can see the damage reduction percentage corresponding to the current Physical or Magic Defense.

8. Optimized the camera movement when dragging the map and mini-map to make it smoother and faster.

9. Optimized the character movement logic in matches and fixed an issue where characters could twitch or lag when moving.

10. Optimized targeting logic for single-target skills to make them more reasonable for heroes to pursue.

11. Optimized the display of the Fighters Stage Avatar Border from the KOF collab event.

12. Optimized the visuals of each interface within the match, with a clearer visual order, a more consistent icon design element, and art style.

13. Painted Skins can now use Skin-exclusive Custom Actions in matches.

14. Adjusted the lane assignment icon of some heroes to match their main roles.

15. Adjusted the effect of the Flicker spell in BRAWL to be consistent with that in the standard mode. Now, some heroes can cast Flicker properly while using mobility skills.

16. To match the activation range of the Last Hit Attack for Turret with the attack range of the Turret itself, we changed the activation range of the Last Hit Attack for Turret from 8 units to 7 units away from the Turret.

Bounty System Optimization

The Bounty system for ending kill streaks and the Team Bounty system have long helped the disadvantaged team catch up to the advantaged team, providing more opportunities for a comeback. However, due to the lack of visuals, many players still do not understand these mechanisms, making it difficult to develop tactics targeting the enemy's high bounty targets.

In this patch, we have added a display of the current bounty amount for each hero on the scoreboard (only displayed if the bounty is not less than 120 Gold), indicating the extra Gold the killer can get for eliminating that hero. We hope this will help players make better use of this mechanism to plan their tactics and ensure victory.

Additional Notes: The Killing Spree Bounty increases with the number of consecutive kills the hero makes, but is only awarded to the player who ends the spree. The Team Bounty increases by the amount the hero is ahead of the opposing team's average economy. When a leading hero is killed, the Team Bounty is distributed to all players on the killer's team.
